create_function_render_masklet_frame: render masklets and bounding boxes on a single image frame with configurable overlay alpha
create_function_save_masklet_video: save a video with masklet overlays rendered on each frame and re-encoded via ffmpeg
create_function_visualize_formatted_fram: visualize up to three sets of segmentation masks on a video frame with optional prompt annotations
create_function_convert_coco_to_masklet_: convert COCO format annotations to the masklet format expected by render_masklet_frame
create_function_get_all_annotations_for_: retrieve a frame image and its associated masks and noun phrases from a dataset annotation dataframe
